records.text: Erika Kirk's lawyer told Candace Owens that he did not have more evidence than the public had about Charlie Kirk's assassination.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #10 (Ep h76ZN-xXC6c)

appearances.snippet: And when a lawyer came on the phone, I said, do you have more evidence than the public has? ... I assume you do. He said no.
